ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 cancellation fee; no refund. Advise rider that cancellations after the 3-minute grace period are chargeable regardless of whether the driver has arrived (Ryde has no "driver late vs ETA" free-cancellation rule).

rejected_claims.reason: Rider's ground that the driver 'had not even arrived' is not a valid basis to void the fee — NS-4 makes the fee turn solely on the 3-minute grace period, which expired at 08:43:00 while cancellation occurred at 08:46:40 [F4]; Ryde publishes no ETA-based waiver (NS-8 informational only).
Driver's post-trip statement is a claim only; it was not needed and the arrival it asserts is independently corroborated by GPS/timeline [F1, F3, F6].
